name: Project;Sunset - Diana & Claire
source:
A story featuring Diana and Claire Gomez, a mother and daughter that tend to get carried away in the heat of the moment, anything could happen when dealing with these types of women.​

[From Patreon]
translation:
故事围绕戴安娜与克莱尔·戈麦斯母女展开。她们总容易在一时冲动下忘乎所以，与这样的女人打交道，什么都有可能发生。

[摘自Patreon]
